GENERATE BURST K3-gen-idle-01 — Keeper idle-S loop, frames 0–3 via EDIT-CANVAS (charter § 7 K3; X2 mechanism: the approved frame sits in slot 0 of the 2×2 canvas and every new frame is generated with an approved neighbour in-canvas). task_id "K3-gen-idle-01".

Image 1 is a 1254×1254 2×2 canvas on a pure #00ff00 plate: SLOT 0 (top-left) already holds the APPROVED rest frame of the Keeper (direction S, facing the camera); slots 1 (top-right), 2 (bottom-left), 3 (bottom-right) are empty green. Deliver EXACTLY ONE image: the SAME canvas with slots 1–3 filled by the next three consecutive frames of a gentle standing idle, row-major order — frame 1 begin inhale, frame 2 middle inhale, frame 3 gentle breath peak — and SLOT 0 LEFT PIXEL-IDENTICAL. Every frame is this exact character (a young woman; dark curly hair tied back; ivory shirt; navy sleeveless tabard, plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her LEFT hip; one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; plain walnut staff with brass ferrules held upright in her RIGHT hand) at IDENTICAL size, position, camera (elevated three-quarter, projection C), facing (S) and light (single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, fixed; no floor shadow). Motion is SUBTLE: shoulders and chest rise slightly with the breath, the staff tip drifts a few pixels, the hair mass barely moves; both feet stay planted on the same line; the head size and the body height are identical in all four cells. Keep exactly four square cells with no borders, labels or gutters. Do not mirror. Do not zoom. Do not matte. No insignia anywhere.

One image_gen call (edit/reference mode on Image 1); ONE retry only if a cell is off-plate, mirrored, or slot 0 was altered — name the retry reason. Copy the final output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/k3_idle_S_00_03.png and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K3-gen-idle-01"): images = the one file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls (1 or 2); status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: the 2×2 edit canvas: slot 0 = approved rest frame (keep pixel-identical); fill slots 1–3
